description: This Java class implements a servlet filter (ContentUrlFilter) that intercepts HTTP requests to handle content URL rewriting and alias checking within the OFBiz framework. It processes request URLs ending with '-content', queries content-related entities, and forwards requests accordingly.

classes.name: ContentUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that processes incoming HTTP requests to handle content URL rewriting and alias resolution within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that intercepts requests, performs URL analysis, queries content entities, and forwards or continues processing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service.
